## About me

Hi my name is David Potter but I go by my middle name Marshall. I am from McKinney, Texas which is a suburb north of Dallas and I am currently studying Economics and pursuing a minor in Statistics and Data Science. I grew up playing all kinds of sports as a kid and I still enjoy lifting and working out. I usually can be a very laid back guy but around the right people I become very social. In the perfect world I hope to continue to live in Dallas where I will be close to my family. 

Find me on GitHub: [github.com/marshallpotter3505](https://github.com/marshallpotter3505)

## Hobbies

- Watching sports or going to sporting events
- Playing video games with my peers 
- Spending quality time with my friends
